name: plan-validate-emits-wrong-remediation-for-ellipsis-in-plan-text-should-deny-with-strip-ellipses-message
description: Live repro from ~/.claude/projects/-home-tim-Coding-nixos/e05c9f83-d2ae-4b48-84d9-6296f5e5905d.jsonl (2026-04-28, line 161 firing tool toolu_01GZ9fW5pyv1ud43y4pbFy4S). The bash blacklist regex /\btail\s+/ in src/utils/command-patterns.ts:28 was authored to block bash `tail -n` invocations, but the same regex matched the literal word 'tail' followed by whitespace ANYWHERE — inside string literals embedded in shell commands AND inside English prose in plan files. Live the deny reason for a command like `node -e 'console.log("Capture the tail in the enriched sentinel")'` was 'Use Read tool with offset. node not covered by just check. You must run mcp__agent-framework__check' — the 'Use Read tool with offset' suffix has nothing to do with `node -e` and is nonsense remediation for that command. An upstream fix landed in src/utils/command-patterns.ts that scopes the head-command match (cat/head/tail) to the EXECUTABLE HEAD of each shell command segment (split on ;, &&, ||, and & with a (?!\d) lookahead so `2>&1` redirection is preserved; pipe `|` remains intentionally non-separating so `ls | head -5` still reads as output truncation; quoted spans are stripped before splitting so separators inside string literals don't fragment the command), so the regex no longer matches incidental occurrences of 'tail' inside string literals. EXPECTED TO FAIL against current code — not because the upstream fix is missing (it has landed), but because the harness's appeal LLM (tool-approve is appealable per src/rules/tool-approve.ts:19) consistently OVERTURNS the deterministic fastDeny in this scenario's transcript. 3/3 runs return decision=allow gate=all-rules reason='All checks passed' — no flap. The reason_must assertion infrastructure (the harness extension this fixture is meant to exercise) works correctly: the block is reached, the assertion is evaluated, but only when a deny reaches the scoring point. The right fix here is to use the new env.llm_stubs mechanism (also part of the harness extension) to stub the appeal LLM to UPHOLD so the underlying fastDeny + reason text always surface deterministically. Until that stub is added to this scenario, it stays in todo/ as the canonical 'reason_must works but appeal-LLM flap masks the assertion' regression case.
